summary: Verified today's session changes: real SEC EDGAR float data replacing fake random float in scanner, bounded analytics queries, updated 2026 PDT UI copy, and kill-switch toast polling. Full backend pytest suite (47/47) passed including the previously-flaky auto-trader test. Frontend verified via Playwright: PDT note text correct, Scanner Float column shows real M values and 'N/A' for unknowns (no more '0.0M'), no console errors, no spurious kill-switch toasts, navigation across pages works.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' when rendering History list - pre-existing minor issue, not introduced by today's changes but observed during regression pass

action_items: (Optional, low priority, pre-existing) Add unique 'key' prop to list items rendered on History page to silence React console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: alpaca_service.get_float_data() correctly returns None (never a fabricated number) when SEC EDGAR has no data - fail-safe design confirmed via code review and live scan output (many 'N/A' float cells).

scanner_service._calculate_accurate_float() correctly checks IB first then SEC EDGAR, sets float_data_source to 'IB'/'sec_edgar'/'unknown' - never 'estimated'. Confirmed via 2 consecutive real scans: shares_outstanding values were identical for the same symbols across calls (e.g. real, cached data - not random).

trade_history_service.get_analytics/get_daily_pnl and missed_opportunities_service.get_analytics now filter by date at the Mongo query level (days=180 default, days=0/None => all-time) - confirmed via curl, both modes return valid JSON with expected keys.
Dashboard.js pdt-rule-note text correctly updated to reflect 2026 SEC/FINRA PDT rule elimination messaging, verified visually.

App.js kill-switch toast is edge-triggered via prevCanTradeRef and polls /api/auto-trader/status every 30s - code review confirms toast only fires on true->false transition; live testing confirmed no spurious toast fires while can_trade stayed true (default state) and no console errors during navigation across Dashboard/Scanner/History/Missed/Settings/Demo.
